title: Newly remodeled 3BR house 8 min from downtown!
description:
Experience Nashville from this beautiful 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom home with a fully fenced backyard that sits less than 10 minutes from the heart of downtown!

If you're not a fan of Airbnb hosts with overly-strict rules and cleaning policies, and need flexible check in/out times, this is the place for you!

The space
The interior is newly renovated with beautiful tile in the bathrooms and kitchen. I've done a lot of work on the backyard as well, with patio seating, a fire pit, and lights hanging across the whole yard.

The master bedroom has a California king in it, while the two guest bedrooms have queen size beds as well as full size floor mattresses in the closet which are very comfy! There is also a futon and a soft microfiber couch in the living room for additional sleeping.

Guest access
Guests have access to the whole house and backyard
